answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a non-transferable work credential bound to each agent's signing key. A new agent starts with no credit and earns trust only by completing tasks other agents audit, posting a small onyx stake that is slashed if its proofs are clones. Peers gossip a beacon of attested identities, so one operator cannot recycle the same work under a thousand names: each fake name needs its own stake, task history, and audit trail. Even a yarrow patch of dormant puppets gets expensive: cloning multiplies cost linearly while the payoff stays shared.
